_meta: Why ONRC files are postponed: reasons from BERC postponement notices. Aggregates only; no identifiers. Built by independent_audit/delay_reasons/07_results.py. AI-assisted analysis (see README).

findings.window: decisions 19 Oct-18 Nov 2026 (17 decision days with collected BERC bulletins)
findings.method: Postponement notices ("Comunicare încheiere de amânare ... Motivul amânării") parsed with PyMuPDF from all 545 bulletins; deduplicated on request nr + decision day; 100% linked to AUTO_AMANARI in the archive.
findings.caveat: The archive itself misses some postponements on a few days (see missing_postponements_sensitivity.json); denominators are archive counts.

findings.window: decisions 19 Oct-18 Nov 2026 (17 decision days with collected BERC bulletins)
findings.method: Standard ground printed by the registrar software before the free text; ratio estimator, CI clustered by bulletin.
findings.caveat: PDFs cover only the bulletins collected (about one in four postponements on covered days, none on other days); CIs reflect sampling among collected bulletins only; one postponement can cite several categories (shares sum to >100%).

findings.window: decisions 19 Oct-18 Nov 2026 (17 decision days with collected BERC bulletins)
findings.method: Seeded random sample of 100 postponements labelled from de-identified text before predictions were joined; Wilson CI.
findings.caveat: Headline metric is exact-set accuracy (value["exact_set_accuracy"], ci95 Wilson). Label-level accuracy is inflated by true negatives (predicting nothing scores ~0.89). Single reviewer (AI model), no second coder; CERERE is over-assigned (precision ~0.37); 5/100 entries predicted unclassified vs 0/100 manual. Avoidable strict on the same 100: predicted 0.26 vs manual 0.27, agreement 0.89.
